name: v0.3.45 — Always-fresh in-app screens + cleaner dashboard
releaseNotes:
• Reports, Steals, Stores, Rewards, Guacanomics & GuacWizard now show the latest experience right inside the app — so they stay up to date the moment we ship improvements, no app update needed.
• Steals: now includes the spec search, the date-sorted “Fresh Steals” feed, and “new steals found” notifications.
• Dashboard: secondary shortcuts (Steals, Rewards, Stash, Inbox, Miles) are now a tidy icon menu under the headline pills.
• Bottom bar: the selected tab lifts into a raised, highlighted icon.
